title: Add artifact smoke test for protected static routes
description: Verify a staged/standalone artifact serves a protected localized route and all required static assets without a source checkout.
acceptanceCriteria: The smoke test starts the standalone server with a temporary database and disposable secrets
It requests login and protected dashboard routes, checks auth behavior, and loads referenced JS/CSS/media assets
Required asset 404s, MIME errors, unprotected shell responses, or startup errors fail the test
The test cleans temporary data and does not print credentials

steps.description: Create a test that starts the staged server or a minimal HTTP fixture and asserts a protected route plus its referenced assets respond correctly.
Parse returned HTML for local static references and request each with the correct locale and auth context.
Fail on non-2xx assets, missing content types, unauthenticated panel content, or health failure; write only sanitized failure summaries.
Run against a complete staged artifact and a deliberately incomplete fixture to verify both outcomes.

technicalNotes: Use a disposable local database. Do not use real `apps/web/.env.local` values or production tunnel data.
